name: Hari Tailor
description: An elegant, precise and traditional theme for a bespoke tailor's atelier making made-to-measure suits, jackets and overcoats: navy wool, chalk paper and muted brass only, Libre Bodoni over Geologica. A navy side rail holds the wordmark, the menu and a booking link beside a brass tape-measure tick scale (a navy top bar with the same scale on phones). The home page opens on the atelier photograph framed by the tape scale, then the five fittings (measure, cut, baste, first fitting, finish) as a numbered tailor's-chalk timeline on a navy wool band with dashed chalk line and chalk crosses, swatch cards from the cloth book with CSS-woven herringbone, chalk stripe, birdseye and flannel, the atelier story with a quote, an appointment call and the journal. The footer is the appointment hours table beside the atelier address on navy. With The Process (the full timeline with photographs), Cloth Book (eight swatch cards and a weight guide), Appointments, About, Contact, Newsletter and Journal. The atelier details and appointment hours are one synced pattern, edited once.
